name: Runs Produced: the best 20 seasons since 1901
title: The 20 best Runs Produced seasons since 1901, beside their Runs + RBI
description: Every AL and NL player's season, 1901-2025, ranked by Runs Produced (R + RBI − HR), a player's seasons each counting on their own. Beside each Runs Produced bar, his Runs with his RBI stacked on top: the stack stands taller by his home runs, each being both a run and an RBI.
